issues.description: The Stock.getStockIngredients() method has different return types in the template and the solution. In the template repository Stock.getStockIngredients() returns List<StockIngredient>, while in the solution repository it returns StockIngredient[]. This mismatch across artifacts can confuse students about which type to use when interacting with the stock (for example when iterating or when assigning the result), and may cause compilation or adaptation problems when they follow one artifact but refer to the other.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the return type of getStockIngredients() across artifacts. Either change the template's getStockIngredients() to return StockIngredient[] (and update any code that expects a List) or change the solution's method to return List<StockIngredient>. Update any usages (e.g., in Main or other classes) to match the chosen type so students have a consistent API to follow.
